change_class: NEW PUBLIC SURFACE — a venue regime screener over the bar-close regime snapshot; every row field is a field get_market_regime already serves, plus the regime's start and age
change_note: One row per coin is the market regime classifier's output for the last CLOSED bar, written hourly by the regime-snapshot sampler through the same core get_market_regime projects from (src/lib/market-regime-core.ts). The response is built by naming permitted keys (toRegimeScanRow / applyRankEcho), never by spreading a stored row, so a column added to regime_snapshots cannot reach the wire. `underlying_session` is recomputed at scan time from asset_class; the stored compute-time value never leaves the DB. Lens echo fields appear ONLY when the caller names rankBy, and only the fields of that lens — funding_rate / funding_apr only under a funding lens. Every refusal (invalid_parameter, venue_not_sampled, timeframe_unserved, quota_exhausted, snapshot_stale) is unbilled and carries no internal identifier.
source: src/tools/scan-market-regimes.ts (runScanMarketRegimes) + src/lib/market-regime-scanner.ts (scanMarketRegimes, toRegimeScanRow) + src/lib/scan-shared.ts (applyRankEcho, buildScanQuotaState); pre-deploy capture
regimes_row_lens_keys_note: Emitted only when rankBy names a lens other than the default oi, and only the typed fields that lens carries (src/lib/scan-shared.ts applyRankEcho — the ONE lens-field list scan_trade_calls also projects through).
forbidden_keys_note: `underlying_session_at_compute`, `rule_version`, `disposition` and `ref_close` are regime_snapshots / regime_snapshot_runs columns: the store keeps them for the producer and the freshness canary, and none is a caller fact. `call` is forbidden because this tool classifies regime; it never emits a trade call.
